items.back: Of the cases where B happened, the share where A happened too.

items.prompt: A test is 90% sensitive. Which is 90%?
items.why: Sensitivity is about people who have it: how often they test positive.

items.wrong: If the test is 90% accurate, a positive means a 90% chance you have it.
items.right: That depends on the base rate: with a rare condition most positives are false positives.

items.prompt: 1 in 100 people have the condition. Out of 1,000 people, how many have it?
